notes.title: Four New Announcements
notes.content:
My name is Ternox, and I’m an indie developer. Recently, I’ve also become an indie publisher of small games — mostly visual novels — as I run the Ukrainian Visual Novel Jam and look for interesting projects that could use some help with promotion.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/25363761/88a36b136b3516cbf8ce55cf6edc23fcdccd6fbb.jpg[/img]

Together with other developers, we’ve prepared four game announcements you can already add to your wishlist.

[h1]Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: TERNOX
[b]Art[/b]: Lumeish
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E6PSbDWXbXM
Valkyrie Iteration is a mini raising sim where you train Lana to battle mysterious phantoms — beings from another dimension tearing apart the fabric of reality.

To face this threat, humanity created Valkyries — giant combat mechs with souls of their own. These living machines have instincts and personalities, accepting only pilots capable of forming a deep emotional bond with them.

Plan Lana’s days, choose which stats to train, and hope she can make it to the finale without defeat.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3466240

[h1]Manic Pixie Dreamgirls[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: Kajan Collaboration
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QNpjwkGZYVU
A team of friends is creating a nostalgic visual novel inspired by early 2000s anime. Manic Pixie Dream Girls tells the story of half-fae students who enter their classmates’ dreams, influence their subconscious, and battle nightmares.

The style blends influences from Persona, Madoka Magica, and Tumblr-era aesthetics. Key moments present three choices, one of which always leads to a bad ending. Several artists and writers work on the project with the goal of recreating the vibe of eerie, old-school anime.

The visual novel was one of the winners of Ukrainian Visual Novel Jam #5 and is now being prepared for full release on Steam. You can already support the developers by adding it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828970

[h1]Born for the Light ~Wavelength Radiant Collapse~[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: qDrot
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VPv7onYDmVs

Solo developer qDrot is working on Born for the Light ~Wavelength Radiant Collapse~.

According to the developer, the project defies conventional expectations, exploring themes of religious trauma and illusions through the eyes of the protagonist.

The story unfolds in a world where children live high above the earth, inside a giant Tree, believing that one day they will fly to a distant Kingdom. The narrative leaves many questions unanswered, inviting players to search for meaning themselves.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776830/

[h1]Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: TERNOX
[b]Art[/b]: Phantom__651
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DH0RvraByjs
Remember “desktop companions” from the 2000s — when a little character would walk around your screen, sit on window edges, or perch on the Start bar? I decided to bring that idea back, but turn it into a full-fledged game — a quirky mix of idle game, raising sim, virtual friend, and even a touch of dating sim.

The main heroine is Akari from my visual novel PockeDate!, now ready to live right on your desktop. You’ll manage her schedule, give her tasks, help her study, socialize, and build her singing career, while also taking care of her mood and rest.

Desktop Akari will run over everything you do, not in a separate window, so she’ll always be there. Release is planned for early next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702590

notes.title: Update 0.6.2: Investment Improvements
notes.content:
- A new difficulty parameter called "Luck" has been added — if things feel too easy, try again on realistic difficulty and forget about lotteries, expensive gifts from friends, and other freebies.
- Investment projects can now be improved using your contacts — up to three of them will offer suggestions on how to make the project better.
- Investment projects can now come from companies listed on the stock market — the outcome will affect their share price and income.
- Investment projects are now tied to a specific business sector — their results may influence the entire sector.
- Company sectors have been revised — there are now 8 instead of 11 (some were merged).
- If you have an old save file (before version 6.1), you can now optionally create your profile and choose a name, appearance, birthday, and biography elements (though not all perks will be available).
- Companies can now perform stock splits — if the share price becomes too low or too high, they may multiply or divide all shares. The value of one share changes, but the total value does not.
- There’s now a 33% chance that instead of going bankrupt, a company will do a stock split to stay listed longer.
- The average share purchase price is now calculated more accurately (using the moving average method).
- When selling stocks, you’ll now pay tax only on the profit — the difference between your average purchase price and the selling price.
- Car accidents now happen slightly less often.
- Fires will also occur a bit less frequently.
- The Financial Services Agency now does its job a little better.
- The "Fortune Teller" biography now has a slightly lower chance of predicting a bad future.
- Some buttons now support hotkeys.
- Updated Chinese translation by Stevezxc.
- Fixed a bug that miscalculated the income required for the "Successful Leader" milestone.
- Fixed a bunch of minor bugs.

notes.title: STONKS-9800: Update 0.5
notes.content:
Finally fixed a claw machine!

[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Mini-Game: "UFO Cosmic Claw" – a claw machine arcade game where you can collect various items.
[*] Item Gifting: Send collected items to your friends via mail.
[*] Calendar System: Keep track of shareholder meetings, holidays, and planned events, including court hearings.
[*] New Random Event: Companies can forecast their revenue to impress investors.
[*] Additional Random Events: A few more surprises to keep things interesting.
[*] Investment Center: Build an investment center to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
[*] Bar Gossip: Friends in the bar occasionally share rumors about various companies.
[*] Temple Donations: You can now choose the size of your donation at the temple.
[*] Reputation Perks: Reputation levels now grant new advantages, detailed in the "Profile" tab. These include (but are not limited to):
[*] High public reputation increases the chance of being invited to spend time with directors and board members.
[*] Speeches by highly reputable players have a stronger impact on the company.
[*] The ethics level affects the speed of friendship growth with Amy.
[*] Temple donations can reduce stress and boost happiness.
[*] Friendships won't drop below a certain level if you have a high networking stat.
[*] High networking helps you make friends faster.
[*] High market reputation lets you buy more shares during IPOs and on the stock exchange, and reduces stock purchase fees.
[*] Bank terms are now clearly displayed based on your financial reputation level.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Gamepad Support: Hoshisama is now controllable with the gamepad stick.
[*] Popup Navigation: Interacting with buttons in popups is now easier using a gamepad.
[*] Expense Tracking: Hover over your total funds at the top of the screen to see recent expenses and income in all menus.
[*] Balance Visibility: Easily identify which transactions affect your balance.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustments:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Yakuza services are now cheaper.
[*] Achievements now grant slightly fewer reputation points.
[/list]


[h2]Other Enhancements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Text Display: Certain parts of messages are now highlighted with different colors for better readability. Text appears in a more user-friendly manner.
[*] Home Screen Updates: Slight rearrangement of elements. Chibi Amy now reminds you about holidays and upcoming events.
[*] Improved Animations: Popup animations have been refined for a smoother experience.
[*] Holiday Greetings: Amy will now personally greet you on all holidays.
[*] Sound Effects: Added sound effects for character dialogues and for spending or earning money.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping sounds when casting the fishing rod during fishing.
[*] Fixing all sorts of small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Celebrating one year of Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a year since I launched [b]STONKS-9800: Stock Market Simulator[/b] in Early Access, and I'm deeply grateful to everyone who's joined me on this journey to improve the game. Just so you know, TERNOX isn't a company. It's just me, working solo, occasionally outsourcing some graphics to bring our ideas to life. This has become my biggest project, and honestly, it's been quite a ride keeping up with it.

Over the past year, STONKS-9800 has expanded massively:

[list]
[*] Enhanced company management and a CEO mode
[*] The ability to interact with everyone you know
[*] Golf, an arcade hall with a shoot'em up game and gachapon, poker, fishing
[*] Yakuza events, financial regulations, and much more
[*] The game even got a Korean translation!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=8Yv3hHMvxLs;full]https://youtu.be/8Yv3hHMvxLs[/previewyoutube]

I'm incredibly thankful for all the player feedback which has helped make the game more user-friendly and enjoyable.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

I underestimated the scope of the updates. I hoped to be ready for a full release after a year, but we're not there yet. In fact, this year won't see the full release either, and I'm falling behind on my update schedule again.

So, I'm updating the roadmap once more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/9f61b1805a069d4793ff9f01684d5bd779a33952.jpg[/img]

[b]Already in Update 0.4[/b]:

[list]
[*] New mini-games including golf, arcade games, and fishing
[*] Direct interactions with the Yakuza and through employees
[*] A city map that allows travel to various new locations like parks and temples
[*] Companies can now go bankrupt, merge, or be acquired
[*] Random event mode, annual business rankings, and plenty of smaller updates and news
[/list]

[b]I'll continue to improve stability and add minor enhancements in 0.4, but I also want to share my plans for the major 0.5 update.[/b]

[h3]Expect in 0.3:[/h2]

[list]
[*] A rhythm-based karaoke mini-game featuring my own tracks styled after retro PC-98 sounds
[*] Claw machine mini-game, allowing you to win toys for Amy and others
[*] Enhanced competition among companies in the same sector, giving you a clear view of your rivals
[*] The option to start a charity or research fund to utilize the endless billions if you're particularly successful
[/list]

Future plans (not necessarily in 0.5) include a more comprehensive dating simulator.

In [b]Version 0.6[/b], I plan to introduce commercial real estate, which will offer higher profits but at a higher cost. This update will be dedicated to that expansion.

Afterwards, I'll focus on the [b]story mode[/b], which will be the foundation for the [b]full release from Early Access[/b]. The full release might be a bit pricier, and will feature new characters to compete against or befriend.

I appreciate your patience as timelines can be tricky. Thanks again for your support. I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoy making it.

If you're not ready to play in Early Access, I understand. Please consider adding the game to your wishlist and waiting for the full release.

notes.title: STONKS-9800: 0.4 Update - The Beginning of Entertainment
Small update 0.3.0.4
Updated roadmap and plans for the future
notes.content:
I understand that many of you might be disappointed with the new timelines, but this is a necessary step to allow me to work on the game at a somewhat reasonable pace and still have free time for other projects.

However, you won't have to wait 3-4 months for each update – I will now be rolling out updates gradually so that you're not left without new content for extended periods. The next major planned update, "0.4 Entertainment," will begin to roll out in December, possibly even a bit earlier.

For instance, from the upcoming content, you'll get more vacation events (and a new mini-game!) as well as increased interactions with the Yakuza, including in the context of company management. You will receive all this without waiting for me to complete everything planned for version 0.4, so don't be surprised if the subsequent 0.4 update doesn't bring as much content.

This approach will also help me better monitor the game's balance and address bugs more progressively.

[h2]About 0.3 update[/h2]

Regarding the 0.3 update, I might have overestimated my capabilities and ended up creating content that perhaps should have been released later. This particular mode feels like a standalone DLC (which I'm not planning to make yet, as I want to complete the full version of the game first). However, I believe it will be a pleasant surprise for those who start playing now and, at some stage, discover another game within the game.

Moving forward, I'll focus on the game's main theme – the stock market. And also on Emi. Emi will receive more content and costumes, which is something I personally want.
Thank you for sticking with me! Thanks to your feedback, the game is improving, so please continue to share your thoughts.

[h1]Updated Roadmap[/h1]

notes.title: STONKS-9800 devlog #2: Reputation
notes.content:
Hello, fellow traders!

Today I want to tell you about an important thing: the reputation system in the game.
In STONKS-9800, your reputation isn't some fancy metric. It's like your shadow in the game, showing how well you're doing across a whole bunch of things that make up the life of a businessman. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/b12df74fdfd82447c0b1581bac660ba7cb53c847.png[/img]

Here's the structure of the criteria that form your reputation:

1. [b]Public Image[/b]: This is all about how you are perceived by the general public and the media. It will rise when you maintain a clean and scandal-free image. It's all about PR here.

2. [b]Financial Success[/b]: As the saying goes, money talks. Your financial prowess, captured by your total net worth, annual profit, and asset growth, speaks volumes about your business acumen.

3. [b]Ethical Conduct[/b]: Here's where your moral compass comes into play. Collaborating with the Yakuza and engaging in illicit activities can offer short-term gains, but will negatively impact this score.

4. [b]Networking[/b]: This isn't just about whom you know, but how you maintain these relationships. Attend social events, make the right friends, and your networking reputation will soar.

5. [b]Market Knowledge[/b]: Are you on top of the latest trends? Do you have a knack for predicting market shifts? Prove it, and watch your market knowledge reputation grow.

6. [b]Philanthropy[/b]: Generous donations and charity work boost your philanthropy reputation. After all, a businessman's role isn't limited to just making profits.

7. [b]Innovation[/b]: Pour money into developing and promoting novel technologies or revolutionary ideas. Taking the lead in innovation always makes a mark.

8. [b]Overall Reputation[/b]: The ultimate reflection of your standing in the business world, this is the sum total of all the above facets.

Each of these dimensions will not only influence how the world perceives you but also unlock new gameplay possibilities. A solid reputation might attract exclusive deals, special events, and unique opportunities, while a questionable reputation might incite public backlash or even attract government scrutiny.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: STONKS-9800 devlog #1: Amy
notes.content:
Hello! It's Ternox.

I've decided to start a devlog of STONKS-9800 as I'm getting closer to releasing the game in Early Access. The devlog will continue as long as the game is updated, even after release. I'm excited to share my progress with everyone and give some insight into the development process. 

Well, you probably already know what the game is about, right? Maybe you've even played the demo and noticed that Amy plays the role of a player's assistant. And I decided to expand her role a bit. But I should warn you that the game is still primarily a fun stock market simulator, so don't expect it to become a fully formed visual novel.

[h2]So, first devlog about Amy. Who is she?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/5877045cb8bc766c4e41fc6a1f481cc78462373c.png[/img]

Amy is a complex character with a range of emotions and experiences, which I wanted to reflect in her dialogues. She's a hard worker and takes her job seriously, but also has a playful and mischievous side to her personality. I wanted to make sure that her conversations with the player were not only informative and task-oriented, but also had some humor and lightheartedness to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/e8b833f8baee1738ff772d38d4cd1fec32351247.png[/img]

To achieve this, I came up with a variety of dialogues that reflect different aspects of Amy's personality. For example, I created dialogues where Amy tells stories from her childhood, shares personal and intimate details from her life, and even gets a little bit tipsy and acts silly with the player while on a walk.

I wanted to create a character that would not only guide players through the game but also provide an engaging and memorable experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/c53636bc9ab28d6cae4ae762be1f9d489b2e5348.png[/img]

I also made sure to incorporate cultural references to Japan in the 80s, where the game takes place, to really immerse the player in the setting and make the dialogues feel more authentic. These references range from famous Japanese works to local customs and traditions.

In addition to crafting her personality and dialogues, I also designed a storyline connected to Amy that runs throughout the game, offering different endings based on the player's decisions and interactions with her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729459/9a43f1e79cf9d77f499240d3da01696707cb866f.png[/img]

This storyline adds a layer of depth and emotional investment to the game, as players will be able to see how their actions impact Amy's life and the development of their relationship. As they progress through the game, players will encounter various events and situations that challenge their bond with Amy and require them to make crucial choices that will ultimately determine the outcome of her story.
But I'll talk about the storylines some other time.

Thank you for your attention, and please add the game to your wishlist! I hope to provide you with an Early Access release date very soon!
